# Abhinav Gupta

> Software engineer building interactive, technically ambitious web experiences. This is his personal portfolio site.

The site is being rebuilt layer by layer. What's live today is the opening scene: an animated mountain atmosphere with a day/night toggle (click the sun). Projects, resume, dev log and contact arrive in later releases and will be listed here as they ship.
